attempts.summary: Deployed a systemd-managed inventory web app on node1, serving on TCP port 8181, while AppArmor (the system's mandatory access control) remained continuously in enforce mode. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy state, rebooted node1 natively, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the service, port, and MAC enforcement all recovered post-restart.
